{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
print("Verifying premises...")
print(f"- Converted column unique values: {sorted(df['converted'].unique())}")
print(f"- Number of missing age entries (-1): {df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()}")

# Filter for converted orders
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]
print(f"- Total converted orders (converted == 1): {len(converted_df)}")

# Check for refunded orders in converted group
refunded_in_converted = converted_df[converted_df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"- Refunded orders among converted: {len(refunded_in_converted)}")

# Exclude refunded orders from converted group (since they did not truly complete checkout)
true_converted = converted_df[converted_df['status'] != 'refunded']
print(f"- True converted (completed, not refunded): {len(true_converted)}")

# Exclude missing age data (-1)
valid_ages = true_converted[true_converted['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
print(f"- Valid ages used (excluding -1): {len(valid_ages)}")

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f"- Mean age of valid converted customers: {mean_age}")

# Output the final mean age
mean_age"}
